title: Director of Quality
text:
**Director of Quality**

Job Type: Full time - Permanent

Location: Bethel, CT📍

A global, private equity backed medical device contract manufacturer is growing fast. With around 20 ISO 13485 certified sites, they make the precision components and sub-assemblies inside many of the world's leading medical devices, from laser-processed nitinol to thin-wall tubing. They're now looking for a Director of Quality to lead product quality and QMS compliance at one of their largest manufacturing sites.

**What you'll do:**

* Own manufacturing quality performance end to end, partnering with Operations to build quality into daily production
* Drive SPC, process capability and data-led problem solving directly on the manufacturing floor
* Lead validation strategy (IQ/OQ/PQ) and quality for New Product Introduction, from development into full-scale production
* Keep the QMS inspection-ready against ISO 13485 and 21 CFR 820, and host FDA inspections and ISO audits
* Be the senior quality contact for high-visibility customers and lead the supplier quality program
* Build, mentor and train a quality team in tools like pFMEA, Gage R&R, RCA and CAPA

**What you'll bring:**

* Bachelor's degree in engineering or management
* 7+ years in a medical device quality management role
* Hands-on manufacturing quality leadership in an ISO 13485 / 21 CFR 820 environment
* Experience hosting FDA inspections and ISO audits
* Lean and/or Six Sigma Green Belt or Black Belt
* Contract manufacturing, finished device assembly, sterilization oversight, eQMS / ERP and CQA (preferred)
* Willingness to travel around 25%

This is a chance to lead quality at a flagship site within a high-growth medtech manufacturer, with real influence on how quality scales across a global network.

degree.text: Bachelor's degree in engineering or management
